# Architecture diagrams

## System context

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {"htmlLabels": false, "flowchart": {"htmlLabels": false}}}%%
flowchart LR
  CISO[Security director] --> IAM[Aegis IAM]
  DPO[Data protection officer] --> IAM
  SUP[Support center] --> IAM
  APP[Consuming applications] <-->|OIDC and decisions| IAM
  IAM --> AUD[Audit]
```

## Components

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {"htmlLabels": false, "flowchart": {"htmlLabels": false}}}%%
flowchart TB
  Portal[COMP-006 Portal] --> Auth[COMP-001 Authentication]
  Auth --> Policy[COMP-002 Policy engine]
  Life[COMP-003 Lifecycle] --> Auth
  Auth --> Recovery[COMP-005 Recovery]
  Auth --> Audit[COMP-004 Audit vault]
  Policy --> Audit
  Auth --> OIDC[IF-001 OIDC]
  Life --> SCIM[IF-002 SCIM]
  Audit --> Events[IF-003 Events]
```

## Authentication sequence

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
  participant U as User
  participant P as COMP-006 Portal
  participant A as COMP-001 Authentication
  participant M as Second factor
  participant V as IF-001 OIDC
  U->>P: Starts login
  P->>A: Sends credential
  A->>M: Requests MFA for privileged role
  M-->>A: Confirms factor
  A->>V: Issues OIDC token
  V-->>P: Returns session
```
